tools.name: pack_containers
tools.description: Pack a list of cargo SKUs into one or more shipping containers using the Kubova solver. Supports bulk loading (cartons straight into the container) and pallet loading (loadingMode:"pallet" + a pallet — cartons are stacked onto pallets first, then the pallets loaded). Per-SKU you can set allowed orie

tools.description: Generate a CAD-style PDF + 3D PNG report for a packing job. IMPORTANT: to keep the report consistent with a plan you already produced, pass the `result` object from your previous pack_containers call — the report then renders that exact plan instead of recomputing.
